photos.c: Ken Onuaguluchi has advanced the Club's discus record on no less than 4 occasions this year hoisting it to a highly respectable 55.28m. A prolific points scorer for our British League Team Ken gained a silver in this years Inter-County Championships.

No, you're not seeing things! It's Ken to Abi in the 4x1 - lane 2 at Battersea will never be the same again as about 8 hundredweight of throwing power dented the track in a semi serious, sorry make that deadly serious relay! The changeover at the bottom bend involved Mike Small and Vince Cornibert.
